citations.assessment: The exact Rava catalogue notice opens with Rava bar Lima, then uses Rabbah bar Lima. London Yuhasin prints a Rabbah/Rava variation in its Lima notice.

evidence.reference: Sefer Yuhasin, Treatise II, London 1857, p. 185
evidence.witness: Sefer Yuhasin, Treatise II, London 1857, p. 185

notes.text: The Rava catalogue and Yuhasin each preserve Rabbah and Rava variants under Lima.
